name: Activity log / trace
summary: The audit surface: every agent action with time, target and result, filterable and exportable; the basis for undo and 'why did it do that'.

name: Agent status and step progress
summary: A persistent, plain-language indicator of what the agent is doing and whether it is blocked on the human.

name: Permission / approval prompt
summary: Gate for side-effecting actions: exact payload, risk framing, and allow-once / always-scoped / deny-with-correction.

name: Autonomy dial / permission modes
summary: Lets the user set how much the agent does without asking, always visible, with a floor of actions that never auto-approve.
aliases: permission modes (Claude Code: default, acceptEdits, plan, auto, dontAsk, bypassPermissions)

name: Background job card and run notifications
summary: Runs the user can leave: a card with status and summary in an inbox, plus distinct done vs needs-input notifications.
aliases: cloud/background agents (Cursor, Codex, Claude Code on the web, Devin)

name: Human-in-the-loop gate / clarifying question
summary: The agent pauses and asks a structured question; the answer is folded back into the run and recorded in the thread.

name: Multi-agent views
summary: A list of runs is the baseline shape; graph canvases are a product in themselves.
aliases: Workflow canvas (AI Elements: Canvas, Node, Edge, Connection, Controls, Panel, Toolbar)

name: Plan view / task list
summary: The agent proposes an editable plan before acting; approval is explicit and changes the agent's mode visibly.

name: Sandbox / browser-use view
summary: Shows what an agent is doing in a browser or sandbox, with narration, approvals and a take-over control.

name: Scheduled / recurring task UI
summary: Management UI for agents that run on a schedule: plain-language cadence, run history, and distinct failure states.

name: Terminal output panel
summary: Console output from agent-run commands, with exit status, ANSI colour and the same follow/release scrolling rule as chat.
aliases: Terminal, StackTrace, TestResults, Snippet (AI Elements Code)

name: Undo / rollback for agent actions
summary: Every reversible agent action can be undone; irreversible ones are gated and labelled before they run.

name: AI summary in lists and cards
summary: A labelled summary that always keeps a path to the underlying content and marks itself stale when sources change.

name: 'Ask about this page' affordance
summary: A consistent, page-aware assistant entry point that shows what context it has.
aliases: Ask Raycast AI about what you're looking at

name: Contextual chips (what the model will see)
summary: The honest representation of context: if it is not a chip, the model did not get it.
aliases: element references (Lovable, v0, Cursor Design Mode)

name: Natural-language command bar
summary: A command palette whose fallback is an AI answer or action, never displacing exact command matches.

name: Selection AI menu (inline AI on text selection)
summary: AI where the user already is: select, choose a verb, review the result next to the original, then replace or discard.
aliases: Inline Action / Restyle / Expand (Shape of AI)

name: Smart autocomplete and auto-fill
summary: AI-proposed field values that look provisional until confirmed and can always be reverted.
aliases: Auto-fill (Shape of AI; Notion database autofill)

name: Voice input, waveform and transcript
summary: Dictation into the composer and full voice conversation, both with a visible transcript.
aliases: Speech Input, Transcription, Audio Player, Mic Selector, Voice Selector, Persona (AI Elements Voice)
Orb, Live Waveform, Voice Button (ElevenLabs UI)

name: Attachment previews and media results
summary: How files and images look in the composer and in messages, including generated media with provenance.

name: Branching and edit-and-resend
summary: Regenerating or editing creates sibling versions that the user can page through without losing earlier attempts.

name: Composer (prompt input)
summary: The single most-used control in an AI product: a form with a growing textarea, attachments, tools, mode/model selection and a send/stop button.

name: Context / token meter
summary: Shows how much of the context window (and budget) a thread has used, with a breakdown on hover and a compaction action.

name: Conversation history sidebar and search
summary: Left rail listing threads grouped by date and project, with search and per-thread management.

name: Error, refusal and scoped-answer states
summary: Three distinct designs: transport errors (retry, keep draft), refusals (calm, offer alternatives) and quota notices (facts and reset time).

name: Inline citation
summary: A compact marker on the claim that reveals its source on hover/focus; cite claims, not paragraphs, and show missing sources as missing.

name: Memory indicator and management
summary: Makes silent personalisation visible: a chip when memory changes, a popover showing which memories shaped an answer, and a management page.

name: Message (user / assistant)
summary: User messages are right-aligned bubbles; assistant messages are full-width, unbubbled containers for ordered parts (reasoning, tools, text, sources, actions).

name: Message actions bar
summary: Copy, regenerate, feedback and share on every assistant message; the feedback signal must be reason-coded, not a mere 'liked it'.

name: Message list / thread
summary: The scrolling conversation container with stick-to-bottom behaviour that releases when the user scrolls up.

name: Model and mode selector
summary: Mode (what the AI is allowed to do) lives in the composer; model (which engine) lives in a secondary menu.
aliases: Model management / Modes (Shape of AI Tuners)

name: Rate limit / quota notice
summary: Honest quota communication: facts, reset time, alternatives, no fake urgency.

name: Reasoning / extended-thinking disclosure
summary: A collapsible, de-emphasised view of the model's reasoning or step trace that opens while streaming and collapses when the answer begins.

name: Sources row / panel
summary: The answer-level view of all sources: a count at the action bar plus an expandable list or side panel.

name: Streaming text + markdown renderer
summary: Renders partial markdown as it arrives without flashing, breaking or leaking unsafe HTML; styles open fences and tables deliberately.

name: Suggested prompts and follow-ups
summary: Specific, contextual prompt buttons at the start of a conversation and after answers; buttons, not text.
aliases: Follow up / Suggestions / Templates (Shape of AI Wayfinders)

name: Thinking / typing indicator
summary: Shimmering status text ('Thinking…', 'Searching the web') shown between submit and first token; prefer specific status over anonymous dots.

name: Tool-call card
summary: Collapsed-by-default card that shows one tool invocation with its seven-state lifecycle, inputs and outputs.

name: AI features inherit the brand (--ai-accent as an alias)
summary: Define AI tokens as aliases of the brand system so AI surfaces look like the product, not like every other AI product.
aliases: Identifiers: Color, Iconography, Name (Shape of AI)

name: AI-specific dark patterns and countermeasures
summary: Maps each documented LLM dark pattern to the UI amplifier to prohibit and the system-level countermeasure.
aliases: DarkBench: brand bias, user retention, sycophancy, anthropomorphism, harmful generation, sneaking

name: Disclosure conventions (collapsed vs expanded by default)
summary: Keeps the thread readable: detail is one click away, blocking states are never hidden.

name: Generative UI rendering policy
summary: Three tiers of model-driven UI, ordered by safety; the catalog supports tier 1 and 2 with its own components.
aliases: open-ended (MCP Apps, OpenAI Apps SDK iframes)

name: Live-region strategy for streamed output
summary: How screen-reader users experience streaming without being buried: batched, transition-based announcements from a single pre-existing region.

name: Message state machine
summary: Name the assistant-turn lifecycle once and make every AI component render from it; it is the first thing to build.
aliases: AI SDK status: submitted / streaming / ready / error

name: Never fake confidence or activity
summary: The system prohibits UI that implies certainty, verification or activity the backend cannot substantiate.

name: Streaming motion tokens and reduced-motion behaviour
summary: Three sanctioned streaming animations, each with a token and a reduced-motion fallback; decorative gradient animation is prohibited.

name: Stop and regenerate are always available
summary: The two controls that make probabilistic, slow output tolerable; their absence is the most common agent-built-UI defect.
aliases: Apple: Edit, Undo, Retry, Adjust near generated content

name: Artifact / canvas side panel
summary: Substantial standalone output (code, docs, apps, diagrams) lives in a panel beside the conversation with tabs, versions and actions.

name: Diff view with accept/reject
summary: Per-file, per-hunk acceptance of AI edits with a global accept/reject and a visible auto-accept policy.

name: Generate button (and the sparkle convention)
summary: The entry point for AI in augmented products: a verb-labelled button, optionally with a brand glyph; never a bare sparkle.
aliases: Generate / Write with AI / Ask AI / Magic Write / Make

name: Generation progress
summary: A ladder from shimmer to steps to a real determinate bar, with a background-job hand-off for long runs.

name: Inline ghost-text completion
summary: Predictive text rendered as dimmed ghost text; Tab accepts, anything else discards; never moves existing text.

name: Preview + chat split layout with live preview pane
summary: The app-builder layout: conversation on one side, a live preview with tabs and a selection-to-prompt toolbar on the other.

name: Variation grid
summary: Show several candidates at once so the user chooses rather than re-prompts; keep the prompt visible and reveal cells as they finish.

name: Version history, checkpoints and restore
summary: Previewable, reversible restore points for both files and conversation, with explicit statements of what a restore does not undo.

name: Capability and limitation pane (empty state)
summary: Where HAX G1/G2 live: what the system can do, how well, and a few specific ways to start.
aliases: Example gallery, Initial CTA, Nudges, Templates (Shape of AI Wayfinders)

name: First-run education
summary: A dismissible explanation of how the AI works that stays reachable, preferably delivered as the first message.

name: Latency patterns (honest perceived performance)
summary: An ordered ladder of honest latency techniques and a list of fakes to prohibit.

name: Skeletons for streamed structured output
summary: Use skeletons only when the output's shape is known; for prose use the thinking indicator instead.

name: AI disclosure label / badge
summary: Marks AI-generated content and is the doorway to explainability; in the EU, first-turn disclosure is required from 2 August 2026.
aliases: AI label (IBM Carbon, formerly AI slug)

name: Provenance for generated media (content credentials)
summary: Generated images carry a machine-readable credential and a visible affordance to inspect it; required in the EU for synthetic media marking.

name: Data-use / training notice and consent
summary: Tells users what data the AI uses and whether it trains on it, with a one-tap opt-out and manual fallback.
aliases: Improve the model for everyone toggle (ChatGPT)

name: Explainability popover ('why this?')
summary: A partial, decision-relevant explanation of why the AI produced this, anchored to the AI element.

name: Feedback collection
summary: Reason-coded feedback that can improve the system without becoming a reward for agreeableness.

name: 'AI can make mistakes' disclaimer
summary: Short, persistent, linked statement that outputs may be wrong; a baseline, not a substitute for citations or uncertainty signals.
aliases: ChatGPT can make mistakes. Check important info.
Claude can make mistakes. Please double-check responses.

name: Model / version badge
summary: Answers 'which model wrote this' and notifies users when the default changes.

name: Safety interstitial
summary: A respectful block screen that coaches the user toward a permitted request instead of shaming or exposing policy text.

name: Confidence / uncertainty display
summary: Show uncertainty as specific first-person language or localised categorical markers; the evidence says raw probabilities do not help.

name: Button
summary: Triggers an action in the current context; the single most-used interactive component in any product.

name: Button Group
summary: Visually joins related buttons into one unit and defines their order of importance.

name: Close Button
summary: The standard dismiss affordance for overlays, banners and removable items.

name: Copy Button
summary: Copies a value to the clipboard and confirms it inline.

name: Floating Action Button
summary: Persistent, elevated button for the single most important action on a screen.

name: Icon Button
summary: A button whose entire label is an icon, used where space is tight and the meaning is conventional.

name: Split Button
summary: A default action plus an attached trigger that reveals related alternative actions.

name: Toggle Button
summary: A two-state button that stays pressed to represent an on/off formatting or filter state.

name: Toolbar
summary: A grouped row of controls that shares one tab stop and arrow-key navigation.

name: Avatar
summary: Represents a person, team, model or entity with an image, initials or icon.

name: Avatar Group
summary: Overlapping avatars summarising a set of people, with an overflow counter.

name: Badge
summary: A small count or status marker attached to another element.

name: Calendar View
summary: Month, week or day grid displaying scheduled events.

name: Card
summary: A bounded surface grouping content and actions about one subject.

name: Chart
summary: A wrapper that gives visualisations consistent tokens, titles, legends, tooltips and accessible fallbacks.

name: Code Block
summary: Multi-line, syntax-highlighted code with copy, language label and optional line numbers.

name: Data Table
summary: An interactive table adding sorting, selection, filtering, pagination and virtualization.

name: Description List
summary: Label-and-value pairs describing a single object.

name: Empty State
summary: Explains why a region has no content and offers the next action.

name: Kanban Board
summary: Columns of draggable cards representing items moving through stages.

name: List View
summary: Vertically stacked rows of structured records with optional selection and row actions.

name: Prose
summary: A styled container that applies the type system to unknown rich content such as Markdown or CMS HTML.

name: QR Code
summary: Renders a scannable code for handoff between screen and device.

name: Stat
summary: A single headline metric with label, value and optional trend delta.

name: Status Indicator
summary: A small dot or light conveying operational or presence status, always paired with text.

name: Table
summary: Static tabular data with headers that describe rows and columns.

name: Tag
summary: A labelled token representing a category, filter or attached value; may be removable or selectable.

name: Timeline
summary: Chronological sequence of events along a vertical or horizontal axis.

name: Alert
summary: Contextual, in-page message about the state of a task, region or system.

name: Error Summary
summary: A single block at the top of a form listing every validation failure with links to each field.

name: Loading Overlay
summary: Dims and blocks a region while an operation completes.

name: Meter
summary: Displays a static measurement inside a known range, such as quota or storage used.

name: Progress
summary: Shows how much of a task is complete, as a bar or a ring.

name: Result Page
summary: Full-page outcome screen for success, error, empty, offline or permission states.

name: Skeleton
summary: Grey placeholder shapes that mirror the layout of content still loading.

name: Spinner
summary: Indeterminate activity indicator for short waits.

name: Toast
summary: Transient confirmation or notice that appears without stealing focus.

name: Calendar
summary: The standalone month grid used inside date pickers or on its own for date selection.

name: Checkbox
summary: Independent binary choice, with a third indeterminate state for parent rows.

name: Checkbox Group
summary: A labelled set of related checkboxes sharing one legend, description and error.

name: Color Picker
summary: Selects a colour through an area, sliders, swatches and a text field.

name: Combobox
summary: Text input joined to a filtered option list, allowing typing plus selection.

name: Date Picker
summary: Structured date entry combining a segmented text field with a calendar popover.

name: Field
summary: The wrapper that binds label, control, description and error into one accessible unit.

name: Fieldset
summary: Semantic grouping of related controls under a shared legend.

name: File Upload
summary: Selects files by browsing or drag-and-drop, then shows per-file progress and results.

name: Form
summary: Groups controls into a submittable unit and owns validation, submission and error orchestration.

name: Input Group
summary: Attaches add-ons, icons or buttons directly to an input's edges.

name: Multi Select
summary: Combobox variant that accumulates several values, usually shown as removable tokens.

name: Number Input
summary: Numeric entry with increment/decrement steppers, clamping and locale-aware formatting.

name: Password Input
summary: Masked text entry with an explicit reveal control and optional strength feedback.

name: PIN Input
summary: Fixed-length code entry split across single-character boxes.

name: Radio Group
summary: Mutually exclusive choice among a small visible set.

name: Rating
summary: Captures or displays a score on a small discrete scale, usually stars.

name: Rich Text Editor
summary: Formatted content authoring with a toolbar and a contenteditable surface.

name: Search Input
summary: Text entry specialised for querying, with search icon, clear affordance and optional suggestions.

name: Select
summary: Custom single-choice picker built from a button trigger and a listbox popover.

name: Native Select
summary: The platform `select` element — the most robust way to pick one option from a short list.

name: Slider
summary: Selects a value (or range) along a continuum by dragging a thumb.

name: Switch
summary: Immediate on/off control for a setting that takes effect without submitting.

name: Tag Input
summary: Free-form entry that converts typed text into removable tokens on Enter or comma.

name: Text Input
summary: Single-line free-text entry, optionally with prefix, suffix or inline actions.

name: Textarea
summary: Multi-line free-text entry, usually auto-growing with content.

name: Time Picker
summary: Structured time-of-day entry with segments and optional list of times.

name: Aspect Ratio
summary: Reserves a fixed width-to-height box so media loads without layout shift.

name: Bleed
summary: Negates parent padding so a child can run edge to edge.

name: Box
summary: Styled generic container that maps style props to design tokens; the escape hatch every other primitive is built on.

name: Center
summary: Centers a single child on both axes within the available space.

name: Container
summary: Centered content well that caps measure and applies responsive page gutters.

name: Divider
summary: Thin rule that separates content groups either visually or semantically.

name: Flex
summary: Flexbox container exposing direction, wrap, align and justify as token-aware props.

name: Grid
summary: Two-dimensional layout with responsive column tracks and token gaps.

name: Resizable Panels
summary: Split layout whose regions are resized by dragging a handle between them.

name: Scroll Area
summary: Scroll container with styled, cross-browser scrollbars and preserved keyboard scrolling.

name: Spacer
summary: Flexible or fixed empty element that pushes siblings apart when a gap cannot express the intent.

name: Stack
summary: One-dimensional layout that spaces children along a single axis with a token-valued gap.

name: Carousel
summary: Cycles through a set of slides in one region, manually or automatically.

name: Gallery / Lightbox
summary: Grid of media that opens into a full-screen viewer with navigation and zoom.

name: Icon
summary: A vector glyph carrying meaning or decoration inside other components.

name: Image
summary: Displays a raster or vector image with sizing, fitting and loading behaviour.

name: Map Embed
summary: Embeds an interactive map with markers and a non-map fallback.

name: Video Player
summary: Plays video or audio with accessible custom controls.

name: App Header
summary: The persistent top bar carrying brand, primary navigation, search and account actions.

name: Back to Top
summary: Floating control that returns the viewport to the top of a long page.

name: Bottom Navigation
summary: Fixed bar of 3–5 top-level destinations at the bottom of a mobile viewport.

name: Breadcrumb
summary: Shows where the current page sits in the hierarchy and lets users climb back up.

name: Command Palette
summary: Keyboard-first overlay that searches across commands, entities and navigation.

name: Context Menu
summary: The same command menu opened by right-click or long-press at the pointer.

name: Dropdown Menu
summary: A button that opens a list of commands acting on the current context.

name: Footer
summary: Site-wide closing region with secondary navigation, legal links and contact information.

name: Menubar
summary: A horizontal bar of top-level menus, as in desktop applications.

name: Navigation Menu
summary: Site-level navigation with hoverable or clickable panels of links (mega menu).

name: Page Header
summary: The title block of a page: breadcrumbs, heading, status, metadata and page-level actions.

name: Pagination
summary: Moves through a paged result set and reports position within it.

name: Sidebar Navigation
summary: Vertical primary navigation, collapsible to icons or a drawer at small widths.

name: Skip Link
summary: The first focusable element on a page, letting keyboard users jump past repeated navigation.

name: Stepper
summary: Shows progress through an ordered multi-step task and, optionally, allows movement between steps.

name: Table of Contents
summary: In-page navigation listing a document's headings, with the current section highlighted.

name: Tree View
summary: Hierarchical list with expandable nodes for nested structures.

name: Alert Dialog
summary: A dialog that interrupts to confirm a consequential or destructive action.

name: Cookie Consent
summary: Regional-compliance banner that requests and records consent for non-essential cookies.

name: Dialog
summary: Modal window that interrupts the flow for a focused task and traps focus until dismissed.

name: Drawer
summary: Panel that slides in from a screen edge for secondary tasks or details.

name: Hover Card
summary: Rich preview of a linked entity shown after a hover or focus delay.

name: Popover
summary: Non-modal floating panel anchored to a trigger, holding rich interactive content.

name: Scrim
summary: The dimming layer behind a modal surface that signals the rest of the UI is unavailable.

name: Tooltip
summary: Brief text label that appears on hover or focus to name or clarify a control.

name: Tour
summary: Sequenced spotlight walkthrough that highlights elements and explains them in order.

name: Accordion
summary: A stack of headed sections that expand and collapse to manage vertical density.

name: Disclosure
summary: A single show/hide toggle for one region of content.

name: Listbox
summary: A focusable list of options where selection is the point, without a text input.

name: Segmented Control
summary: Compact set of mutually exclusive options shown as joined segments.

name: Tabs
summary: Switches between sibling panels of content within the same context.

name: Toggle Group
summary: A set of toggle buttons behaving as one control, single- or multi-select.

name: Blockquote
summary: Sets off quoted material with an accent rule and optional attribution.

name: Inline Code
summary: Marks a short code token inside running text.

name: Heading
summary: Titles a section and establishes the document outline.

name: Help Text
summary: Short supporting copy under a control that explains format, constraints or consequences.

name: Kbd
summary: Renders a keyboard key or chord, and doubles as the shortcut hint on menus and buttons.

name: Label
summary: Names a form control and forms the click/announce association with it.

name: Link
summary: Navigates to another location; the only control that changes the URL.

name: List
summary: Ordered or unordered prose list with token-controlled markers and spacing.

name: Paragraph
summary: A block of running prose with the system's reading measure and paragraph rhythm.

name: Text
summary: The general-purpose typographic primitive for body, label and caption copy.

name: Clipboard
summary: Behaviour that writes to and reads from the system clipboard with fallbacks and feedback.

name: Focus Trap
summary: Confines Tab order inside a region while it is open and restores focus when it closes.

name: Live Region
summary: Announces dynamic changes to screen readers without moving focus.

name: Portal
summary: Renders children into a different DOM node so overlays escape overflow and stacking contexts.

name: Slot
summary: Composition primitive that merges a component's behaviour and props onto a child element.

name: Sortable
summary: Drag-and-drop reordering behaviour with an accessible keyboard equivalent.

name: Theme Provider
summary: Supplies token values and colour scheme to the tree, and exposes the light/dark/system toggle.

name: Truncate
summary: Clips overflowing text to one or more lines with an ellipsis and a way to see the full value.

name: Virtual List
summary: Renders only visible rows of a large collection, with optional infinite loading.

name: Visually Hidden
summary: Hides content visually while keeping it in the accessibility tree.
